name: journeykit
description: Set up JourneyKit in your product and run it from your coding agent: install the SDK, track events and lifecycle stages, verify data arrives, and build journeys.

interface.longDescription: Install JourneyKit in your product without reading the docs. Your agent finds your framework, adds the browser SDK, identifies signed-in users, tracks the events that matter, sends lifecycle stages, and verifies that data reaches your workspace. Then build segments and journeys — automated emails and webhooks measured against a holdout — and ask how activation and conversion are doing, all from the same conversation.
defaultPrompt: Set up JourneyKit in this project
Check whether events are reaching JourneyKit
Draft a journey that nudges users who haven't activated
